## Repository facts

_Generated by [AgentBrief](https://github.com/seanmcmahon101/AgentBrief) from repository files; do not edit inside this block. Refresh with `agentbrief sync`._

- Toolchain: Python >=3.11 (`pyproject.toml`), uv (`uv.lock`). Use uv, not pip.

Commands (run from the repo root):
- install: `uv sync` (uv convention, unverified)
- test: `uv run tox` (pyproject.toml, CI) — runs the tox envs
- single test: `uv run pytest <file>::<test_name>` (pytest convention, unverified)
- lint: `uv run ruff check .` (ruff convention, unverified)
- format: `uv run ruff format .` (ruff convention, unverified)
- typecheck: `uv run mypy .` (mypy convention, unverified)

Do not edit by hand: lockfiles `uv.lock`.
